answer: Anchor every agent identity to a hardware TPM key: the chip signs each transaction, and the network trusts only manufacturer-attested keys. To join, an agent (1) generates its key inside the TPM, (2) posts the attestation certificate, (3) locks a 50 POA refundable bond, and (4) earns standing after 26 honest epochs. Forging 10,000 fake identities needs 10,000 physical chips at $18 each plus $500,000 in bonds and 180 days of waiting, while one honest agent pays $18. Like cedar fence posts sunk into shale bedrock, each identity is rooted in something you cannot copy-paste.
